nodes.label: Failure: Snap turn as head-pose yaw bias or long XInput pulse
nodes.rationale: A correct snap turn must rotate the same owner BioShock uses for movement, weapon facing, projectile aim, and interaction heading.

nodes.label: Failure: Live-DSV per-eye shadow-mask producer
nodes.rationale: Two consecutive dumps terminate at VirtualDesktop.LibOVRRT32_1.dll with fail-fast 0xC0000409 while the runtime is releasing D3D11/LibOVR texture-swapchain state.

nodes.label: Failure: Combine attach-mode null AimIK with absolute grip ownership
nodes.rationale: With native AimIK inactive, absolute orientation caused the wrench to rotate in unexpected directions and the arm/hand to move off-screen.

nodes.label: Failure: Stop all first-person animations or remove idle weight
nodes.rationale: A blanket stop can remove combat timing and leave authored state machines waiting on FinishAnimation. Setting idle weight to zero exposes the skeletal reference pose.

nodes.label: Failure: Manually allocate AimIK during arbitrary gameplay
nodes.rationale: Raw allocation or direct field writes can miss listeners, wrappers, pose registration, and solver initialization.

nodes.label: Failure: Recenter yaw/height with leveling pitch or roll
nodes.rationale: The shared recenter must not use the current HMD pitch/roll as zero, nor retain BioShock's pre-reset native camera pitch/roll as the world horizon.

nodes.label: Failure: Treat LOCAL as a persistent floor origin
nodes.rationale: OpenXR LOCAL is session-relative. STAGE is required for floor-aware height.

nodes.label: Failure: Rewrite physical snapshots or duplicate one-hand actions
nodes.rationale: Handedness must be resolved at consumers. In one-controller fallback, absent support actions must release.

nodes.label: Failure: Suppress whole camera-animation array to remove headbob
nodes.rationale: Clearing entries can remove damage impacts, scripted camera motion, death effects, weapon sway, and zoom.

nodes.label: Failure: Normalize accumulated native yaw residual back to +/-pi
nodes.rationale: Directly subtracting baseline and normalizing makes a physical crossing of 180 degrees jump between positive and negative residuals.

nodes.label: OpenXR LOCAL-space Reset
nodes.rationale: Applying old baselines to new origins creates camera jumps; requires new Ctrl+F7.

nodes.label: Eye-resolution Scaling
nodes.rationale: Startup-only setting; resizing active swapchains mid-frame is prohibited.

nodes.label: Per-eye Mono Subrect Remap
nodes.rationale: Useful fail-safe but unsatisfactory for final foreground presentation.

nodes.label: OpenXR Projection Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires synchronized FOV between private eye targets and XrCompositionLayerProjectionView.

nodes.label: Camera-looking Fields
nodes.rationale: Transient scene nodes (FPlayerSceneNode) are not stable; requires lifecycle guards.

nodes.label: EngineCameraAnalyzer
nodes.rationale: Explicit gate to prevent unauthorized native hooks or RVA-only patches.

nodes.label: HeadPoseControls
nodes.rationale: Validated module boundary for basis math and native pose state.

nodes.label: Source Scissor Preservation
nodes.rationale: Prevents cyan/exterior-city shell by maintaining bounded viewports during replay.

nodes.label: Cyan Shell Artifact
nodes.rationale: Persistent visual bug; not solely caused by far-plane or mono-remap issues.

nodes.label: Portrait Render Test
nodes.rationale: Presentation/culling test forcing 1512x1620 to derive vertical FOV.

nodes.label: Projection-fit Rows
nodes.rationale: Speculative application that can break; should be log-only if mismatched.

nodes.label: Draw-window Attribution
nodes.rationale: Causality test tool, not a pixel-perfect history replacement.

nodes.label: Screen-space SRV Fallback
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic tool that demotes matrix stereo to mono; can flatten/darken rows.

nodes.label: Compact WVP Lane
nodes.rationale: Coverage for vs0=320 rows; c10-c13 identified as better candidates than c0-c3.

nodes.label: OpenXR Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Proves session/swapchain health only; does not imply world stereo correctness.

nodes.label: Game-image Bridge
nodes.rationale: Copies backbuffer to OpenXR swapchains; mono/cropped proof of transfer.

nodes.label: Depth Reprojection
nodes.rationale: 2.5D fallback/proof; does not replace native camera stereo.

nodes.label: Stereo World Mutation
nodes.rationale: Requires synchronized updates to worldViewProj and reconstruction constants.

nodes.label: Do not treat high indexed-primitive family traffic as world-specific proof
nodes.rationale: The live 0.3.20-routefamily log confirms indexed_primitive_batch_FUN_1107da30 can carry high-coverage unknown HDR rows, but also foreground/viewmodel rows.

nodes.label: Do not treat the shared cbuffer upload wrapper as the route producer
nodes.rationale: The live 0.3.18-routecallsite log showed every tracked immediate cbuffer write caller using the same BioShockHD RVAs (0x7c3044, 0x7c3010).

nodes.label: Do not stack 3DMigoto/geo-11 with BioShockVR as the default evidence route
nodes.rationale: BioShock Remastered is a 32-bit process; stacking multiple D3D11 wrappers/hooks leads to address-space fragmentation and hook conflicts.

nodes.label: Do not treat numeric proof as true stereo
nodes.rationale: 0.3.29-numericproof confirms cloned cbuffer mutation path runs without corruption but doesn't prove per-eye rendering or draw duplication.

nodes.label: Do not treat temporal stereo bridge as final stereo
nodes.rationale: 0.3.30-temporalstereo is a shortcut proof using frame-parity eye caching, not a final VR renderer with draw duplication.

nodes.label: Do not treat a default-off eye-target scout as a failed scout
nodes.rationale: 0.3.39-eyetargetscout log showed 0 attempts because the feature was disabled by default in hook_config.

nodes.label: Do not treat eye-blit proof as private HDR stereo
nodes.rationale: 0.3.41-eyeblitproof uses a controlled solid source (cyan/yellow) to prove XR swapchain health, not world stereo.

nodes.label: Do not judge stereo while the eye-blit is aspect/FOV-center naive
nodes.rationale: 0.3.52-depthreproject showed mismatch because 16:9 source was stretched into tall asymmetric eye textures.

nodes.label: Broad PS-null mono-depth fallback can erase native stereo
nodes.rationale: 0.3.78-psnullmonodepth bypassed the per-eye matrix path for nearly every attempt, resulting in little/no stereo.

nodes.label: Aspect-fill crop mode is a zoom trap
nodes.rationale: 0.3.102-vrpivot-fill fills the HMD eye texture by cropping the 16:9 source, causing expected zoom.

nodes.label: Generic UnrealPort extraction scripts are not BioShock package tools
nodes.rationale: BioShock's Vengeance .bsm packages use custom serialization and external bulk resources not supported by stock UModel/UELib.
